title: Roles are judged in use
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0062 no longer matches the current design.
decision: There are no behavioural evaluations of roles (0142): a role is judged in real use, receiving its declared assignment and nothing a real cut would not give it.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
